QuestInfo.name: Blessings of the Fox God
QuestInfo.0: You can feel the Fox God's blessing around you has gotten stronger. You should try to enhance your bond with the spirit using this power.
QuestInfo.1: You can feel the Fox God's blessing around you has gotten stronger. You should try to enhance your bond with the spirit using this power.
QuestInfo.2: You can feel that your blessing from the Fox God has gotten stronger. If what she said is true, then your existence will not be forgotten even if you cross dimensions. However, for now you are nothing but a stranger to Moonbeam and the other foxes.
